reference_policy: Only returned targets/masks. ZIP reads native observations and original association metadata for unchanged V fragments; no reference/T_test or training members.
native_control_policy: Raw float64 cap128 inputs; shortest signed course/longitude interpolation inside native support and own endpoint hold outside. No target/mask in predictor.
precision_limit: Raw float64 input control, not a bit-identical FP32 normalized/inverted model base. 034 full state_mean/checkpoint was not returned. Uses exact signed half-turn convention; 034 adds FP32 0.000343-degree half-turn tolerance. Residual estimates include rounding.
model_base_control_policy: Second input-only control approximates 034 by casting raw headings and scene-relative times to FP32 and applying its 8*eps*360 half-turn tolerance. Omits unavailable normalization/inversion roundtrip. Residual ablations use this control to avoid attributing different half-turn choices to learned dynamics. No learned layers executed.
mean_ablation_policy: Circular mean heading residual and linear position/log-speed means over all Q64 queries, regardless of target validity; observational ablation, not trained alternative.
interpretation: Single seed20 endpoint, 64 scenes nested in 17 identity components; descriptive only.
9001/reference reuse limits observed-point and denoising claims.
Endpoint-vs-zero residual attribution is descriptive, not an additive causal training decomposition.
No observed heading dynamic contribution implies neither no query input nor no neural gradients.
No threshold or alternative method selected; all original queries retained.
